items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a sensible first step for softening the look of fine lines.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable, hydrated look and helps skin adjust to a new retinol.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use a pea-sized amount of the retinol at night on clean, dry skin two nights a week, then add nights slowly as skin feels comfortable, followed by the moisturizer. Apply the SPF every morning and reapply when outdoors.
